concept.description: Labels the direct sub-packages of the @SpringBootApplication package as :Module (name, fqn).
concept.cypher: MATCH (app:Type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type {fqn: 'org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication'}) MATCH (root:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(app) MATCH (root)-[:CONTAINS]->(p:Package) WHERE NOT p.fqn ENDS WITH '.internal' AND p.fqn <> root.fqn SET p:Module RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS Modules

concept.description: Creates (:Module)-[:DEPENDS_ON_MODULE {weight}]->(:Module) from type dependencies between modules.
concept.cypher: MATCH (m:Module) WITH collect(m) AS mods MATCH (t1:Type)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t2:Type) WHERE NOT t1:Test WITH t1, t2, [x IN mods WHERE t1.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.'][0] AS m1, [x IN mods WHERE t2.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.'][0] AS m2 WHERE m1 IS NOT NULL AND m2 IS NOT NULL AND m1 <> m2 WITH m1, m2, count(DISTINCT t1) AS weight MERGE (m1)-[r:DEPENDS_ON_MODULE]->(m2) SET r.weight = weight RETURN count(r) AS ModuleDependencies

MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method) WHERE m.name IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (m)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(ax:Type) WHERE ax.fqn IN ['org.springframework.modulith.events.ApplicationModuleListener'] } SET m:MessageConsumer, m.consumerKind = 'event', m.registryBacked = true RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS ModuleListeners

constraint.description: Modules must not depend on each other in a cycle.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:Module)-[:DEPENDS_ON_MODULE*2..4]->(a) RETURN DISTINCT a AS Element, a.fqn AS Fqn, 'module participates in a dependency cycle' AS Detail

constraint.description: A module may only use the types of another module's base package (its API), not its internal sub-packages (unless exposed as @NamedInterface).
constraint.cypher: MATCH (m:Module) WITH collect(m) AS mods MATCH (t1:Type)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(t2:Type) WHERE NOT t1:Test WITH t1, t2, [x IN mods WHERE t1.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.'][0] AS m1, [x IN mods WHERE t2.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.'][0] AS m2 WHERE m1 IS NOT NULL AND m2 IS NOT NULL AND m1 <> m2 AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (m2)-[:CONTAINS]->(t2) } AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (sub:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(t2), (sub)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(:Annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type {fqn: 'org.springframework.modulith.NamedInterface'}) } RETURN DISTINCT t1 AS Element, t1.fqn AS Fqn, t2.fqn AS Detail

constraint.description: In-process events inside a module application should use @ApplicationModuleListener (event publication registry) instead of a plain @EventListener.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (m:Module) WITH collect(m) AS mods MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(c:Method:MessageConsumer) WHERE NOT t:Test AND c.consumerKind = 'event' AND coalesce(c.registryBacked, false) = false AND any(x IN mods WHERE t.fqn STARTS WITH x.fqn + '.') RETURN DISTINCT c AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, c.signature AS Detail

constraint.description: No test calls ApplicationModules.verify(): module rules are not enforced at build time.

group.description: tech-spring-modulith - application modules and their boundaries
